_note: Mac cut of the SAME driven tour as scenes.json, from marketing/raw/en/mac/video/capture.mov. `src` is in the SOURCE recording's timebase, which is NOT the tour's: the recorder starts before the app is driven, so every marker sits 1.218 s later here than the REEL_* log says. The window is recorded at 1456x819 (AIRCORE_WINDOW) so 2912x1638 downscales to 1920x1080 with no crop — the earlier 1180x820 window would have lost 19 % off the bottom, and on the pipe scene that is the Darcy-vs-Hazen-Williams comparison the caption points at. Mixing gets 3.2 s rather than 5: after its dwell the tour is walking to the next tool, and navigation footage under a caption about mixing is the drift this file exists to prevent. Total 28.8 s, inside the 15-30 s window, so nothing is sped up.
